description: This file defines a PHP class 'TestlinkXMLRPCServer' for handling XML-RPC API requests in the TestLink test management system. It manages test cases, test plans, test projects, test executions, user authentication, validation, and interfacing with a database. The class extends IXR_Server and includes methods for request validation, user rights checking, retrieving, and inserting test result data, indicating its role as an API server component.

classes.name: TestlinkXMLRPCServer
classes.description: Main class handling XML-RPC requests for TestLink API, managing test cases, projects, plans, executions, user permissions, and database interactions.

classes.name: XmlrpcClass
classes.description: This class handles XML-RPC API requests in TestLink, providing functionalities for test case management, test plan and project management, execution reporting, user rights validation, and more.
